name: niit-mfs-threshold-125000
description: Married filing separately with wages plus interest: pins the $125,000 MFS MAGI threshold for the 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax, where the tax is limited by the smaller of net investment income ($20,000) or the MAGI excess ($25,000).

source.pin: Threshold list verbatim: 'Married filing jointly is $250,000. Married filing separately is $125,000. Single or Head of household is $200,000.' 'The NIIT is 3.8% of the lesser of' net investment income or the MAGI excess.

derivation: NIIT: MAGI 150,000 exceeds the $125,000 MFS threshold by $25,000; net investment income is $20,000; tax = 3.8% x 20,000 = $760.00. (An engine using the $200,000 single threshold here would produce $0 and fail this fixture.)
